knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A chemical peel is a named hazard. The item must be reviewed before it goes on the menu.
An add-on carries its own steps. A patch test required by the product instructions must be carried out and recorded with the add-on.
The package record must link each visit to the services delivered, and each visit must have its own intake and consent record, because a client's health can change between visits.

practicalCriteria: Assessor checks a sample menu and confirms every item is on the approved service list with a review date
Assessor checks a sample add-on and confirms that its steps, time and patch test check are recorded
Assessor checks a sample package and confirms each visit has its own intake and consent record
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Sample approved menu with review date
Sample package record with linked visit records
stopWorkCriteria: An injectable treatment appears on the menu or in an add-on
A service that has not been reviewed is offered to a client
